post.description: Checks the admin password and starts an admin session.

get.description: Returns whether the current session is authenticated.
Returns the effective application configuration with the default and the source of each setting. Secrets are returned empty (Admin only).

put.description: Validates the submitted configuration and writes it to the config file. Does not apply to the running process, a restart is required (Admin only).

post.description: Builds the submitted storage configuration and verifies it is reachable, without saving it (Admin only).

get.description: Returns the heat the timing device currently reports. Overlays receive every change of it through the websocket at /api/ws.
Returns the events, start entries, and competitors of the loaded meet data in the order of the program. Withdrawn start entries are left out.
Returns the competitors of the loaded meet data, ordered by name.
Returns the events of the loaded meet data in the order of the program.
Returns the event with the given number from the loaded meet data.

Returns the event with the given number and the start entries of its heat, counted from 1, with their competitors. The start entries are ordered by lane and relay position, and withdrawn start entries are left out.
Reports for every meet file whether it is available and the name it is stored under (Admin only).

post.description: Stores every file of the "files" field whose name, ignoring extension and case, matches a meet file. The meet data is not reloaded (Admin only).

put.description: Replaces the given meet file. The meet data is not reloaded (Admin only).

post.description: Reads all meet files again. The live heat takes the new data with the next frame of the timing device. A file that cannot be read fails with 400, naming the file and the line, and the previous meet data stays in use (Admin only).

get.description: Returns the start entries of the loaded meet data in the order of the heats, with heats counted from 1. Withdrawn start entries are left out.
Returns the public configuration of the application.
Returns "pong" if the API is up and running.
Returns the names of all AR overlay presets.
Returns the AR overlay preset with the given name.

put.description: Creates or replaces the AR overlay preset with the given name, which has to match the name in the body (Admin only).

delete.description: Deletes the AR overlay preset with the given name (Admin only).

get.description: Returns every record set or equalled at the meet, the most recent first, with the record it broke. Times are in hundredths of a second.

delete.description: Removes every record break, such as before the next meet (Admin only).
Removes the record break with the given id, such as after a disqualification. The next heats are checked against the record that stood before it (Admin only).

get.description: Returns every record table in the order they are checked, with the number of their records.

post.description: Creates a record table under a generated id at the end of the order and imports its records from the file in the "file" field, mapped as the RecordTableCreateRequest in the "data" field describes. A file that cannot be read, a mapping that does not fit, or invalid rows fail with 422 on the fields "file", "mapping.columns.<key>", "mapping.values.<key>", and "rows.<line>.<key>", and nothing is stored (Admin only).

put.description: Puts the record tables in the order of the given ids, which decides the table a record counts for. The ids must name every table once, otherwise it fails with 422 on the field "ids" (Admin only).

post.description: Reads the start of the file in the "file" field in the format of the RecordTablePreviewRequest in the "data" field, detects its empty fields, and guesses the mapping of its columns and values onto the columns of a record. A file that cannot be read fails with 422 on the field "file" (Admin only).

Reads every record table and the records set at the meet again from the storage. A file that cannot be read fails with 400, naming the file and the line, and its previous data stays in use (Admin only).

get.description: Returns the record table with the given id and the number of its records.

put.description: Replaces the name, the abbreviation, and the state of the record table with the given id. Its records stay (Admin only).

delete.description: Removes the record table with the given id and its records. The records set at the meet stay (Admin only).

get.description: Downloads the records of the record table with the given id as a CSV file with the keys of the columns as its header, which imports again without a mapping. The default is UTF-8 with a byte order mark, separated by semicolons, with every column.

post.description: Replaces the records of the record table with the given id with the records of the file in the "file" field, mapped as the RecordTableImportRequest in the "data" field describes. It fails like the creation of a record table and keeps the records on failure (Admin only).

get.description: Lists every stored recording of the timing data and marks the one being written (Admin only).

post.description: Stores an uploaded recording of the timing data under its sanitized filename. A file that is not a recording is rejected (422), as is the name of the recording being written (409) (Admin only).

get.description: Downloads a stored recording of the timing data as JSON Lines (Admin only).

delete.description: Removes a stored recording by name. The replayed recording and the one being written cannot be deleted (409) (Admin only).

get.description: Downloads a stored recording as a CSV table with one row per frame, discarded block, gap, session, and meet line (Admin only).
Returns every record of every record table, in the order of the tables and of the records in their files. Times are in hundredths of a second.
Returns the connection state of the timing device, the event the simulator plays, and the name of the recording it replays.
Compares the running version with the latest release and reports whether this installation can install it itself (Admin only).

post.description: Starts installing the latest release in the background and answers right away. The application restarts once it is installed, see the update status (Admin only).

get.description: Returns the state of the last update started on this instance (Admin only).
Returns all webhooks with the state of their deliveries since the start, sorted by name (Admin only).

post.description: Creates a webhook under a generated id and starts its deliveries. An empty secret is generated. The response is the only one that holds the secret. The URL may use http or https and must not point to a private or local network outside the allowed networks of the configuration (Admin only).

get.description: Returns the webhook with the given id and the state of its deliveries since the start (Admin only).

put.description: Replaces the settings of the webhook with the given id, which take effect with its next delivery. An empty secret keeps the stored one. The URL is checked as on create (Admin only).

delete.description: Deletes the webhook with the given id and ends its deliveries (Admin only).

get.description: Returns the last deliveries to the webhook with the given id since the start, the most recent first (Admin only).
Returns the request a message of the given event with its current data would make to the webhook with the given id, with the signature of its secret. Nothing is sent (Admin only).

post.description: Sends a message of the type webhook.test to the webhook with the given id once, even if it is disabled, and returns the delivery. The delivery shows in the log but leaves the state of the webhook alone (Admin only).

get.description: Upgrades the request to a WebSocket that receives JSON messages with a type and optional data. A client receives the live heat on connect and every change of it afterward.

exists.description: Exists is false until the file at Path is created.

path.description: Path is empty when a save creates a new config file.

secrets.description: Secrets reports by path whether each secret is set, since their values never leave the backend.

sources.description: Sources names by path where each setting comes from.

clearSecrets.description: ClearSecrets lists the JSON paths of secrets to remove. A secret sent empty otherwise keeps its value.

kind.description:
Kind is the source of the value, where a flag or an environment variable overrides the config file,
so a change saved to the file has no effect on such a setting.

name.description: Name is the flag, the environment variable, or the file path, empty for the default.

requestId.description: RequestID matches the X-Request-ID header and the log lines of the request.

phase.description: Phase is the number of the phase of the event.

phaseName.description: PhaseName is the name of the phase, empty if unknown.

time.description: Time is the scheduled start time, empty for an event without one.

competitor.description: Competitor is null if it does not exist.

choices.description: Choices are the values the column accepts, empty for a column that accepts any text.

suggestions.description: Suggestions are further values the values of the file can be translated into, while the column accepts any text.

columns.description: Columns holds the header of the file by the key of a column.

values.description: Values translates the values of the file into the values of a column, by its key and the value in the file.
Values holds the distinct values of every header with few of them, so they can be translated.

records.description: Records holds the records the lane broke or equalled, filled once the lane finished.

ageFrom.description: AgeFrom and AgeTo bound the age the record applies to, 0 for an open bound.

previousTime.description: PreviousTime is the time of the record before in milliseconds, like the times of the lanes, and PreviousName its holder.

firstLane.description: FirstLane is the number of the first lane of the pool, 0 or 1, so overlays can map their lanes to it.

stopTime.description:
StopTime is the heat time in milliseconds the timer stops at once every lane the device reports in use has finished,
the highest finish time among them. It is 0 while a lane in use has not finished.

competitors.description: Competitors are listed once and referenced by id from the start entries.

x.description: X is the horizontal position in the output image as a fraction of its width.

y.description: Y is the vertical position in the output image as a fraction of its height.

x.description: X is the horizontal position in the output image as a fraction of its width.

y.description: Y is the vertical position in the output image as a fraction of its height.

name.description:
Name matches the name in the path and names the file, so 60 characters of up to 4 bytes
stay within the 255 bytes a file name may have.

equalled.description: Equalled reports a time equal to the record, which the competitor then holds together with its holder.

ageFrom.description: AgeFrom is the lowest age the record applies to, 0 for an open bound.

ageTo.description: AgeTo is the highest age the record applies to, 0 for an open bound.

birthYear.description: BirthYear is the year of birth of the record holder, 0 if unknown.

date.description: Date is the day the record was set as YYYY-MM-DD, empty if unknown.

distance.description: Distance is the distance each swimmer swims in meters, a relay leg for a relay.

relayCount.description: RelayCount is the number of swimmers per team, 1 for an individual event.

time.description: Time is the record time in hundredths of a second.

current.description: Current reports whether the recording is being written right now.

encoding.description: Encoding is detected on import when empty.

separator.description: Separator is detected on import when empty.

unsupported.description: Unsupported names why this installation cannot install the release itself, empty if it can.

error.description: Error gives the technical details of ErrorCode for the log.

errorCode.description: ErrorCode names why a delivery got no response, empty if the target answered.

responseBody.description: ResponseBody is the start of the response body.

statusCode.description: StatusCode is the status of the response, 0 if none was received.

secret.description: Secret is only set in the response that created the webhook, since the secret is never shown again.

lastErrorCode.description: LastErrorCode names why the last failed delivery got no response, left out before the first failure.

lastStatusCode.description: LastStatusCode is the status of the response to the last failed delivery, left out before the first failure.

secret.description: Secret keeps the stored one when empty.
